list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned. Names, descriptions and grades as Exophase and PSNProfiles list them; guides are this entry's own words.

notes.hidden: Hidden flags follow the list as PSNProfiles and Exophase show it: the 28 hidden trophies are the story trophies, the side-character finales and the one-off moment trophies. GTABase and Output Lag report the same 27 visible / 28 hidden split.
notes.missable: Only one trophy is flagged as possibly missable by the guides that have checked: Positive Mental Attitude. GTABase and PowerPyx both flag it; Output Lag reports Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward it and disappears after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
notes.online: No trophy needs online play. All 55 unlock in single player; there is no GTA Online mode at launch.
notes.time: Difficulty and time are this guide's own estimates. The full platinum is reported at about 200 hours (Output Lag; Insider Gaming via GTA 6 Insider) and up to 300 hours or more (Push Square), with the story near 50 hours and a 4/10 difficulty (GTADB).

trophies.guide: The platinum lands on its own once the other 54 trophies are done, so treat it as a finish line rather than a task. Expect a long haul: the guides that have timed it put the full run at roughly 200 hours, with the story alone near 50 hours. Work the roadmap in order and it arrives together with the 100% gold.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing through to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes. Nothing here can be missed, so just follow the on-screen prompts and enjoy the introduction to Leonida.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. There is nothing extra to hunt here, but do meditate at Lucia's balcony spot before the chapter ends: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is gone afterwards.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. This is the point where both Jason and Lucia are playable, so most side content opens up after it. Use the chapter break to pick up anything that needs both of them together.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Straight story progress: the trophy pops when the chapter closes, so keep playing the missions through.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Before you push past this chapter, check the meditation spots and any chapter-limited side content. There is no mission replay, so a manual save at the start of every chapter is cheap insurance.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Save manually before it: several guides note the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a save here protects anything you still want from the endgame before the credits roll.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as you play the story and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission: follow it through and the trophy pops on completion.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story trophy; finish the mission and it pops.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission; the trophy pops when it ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission; finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission; the trophy pops on completion.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. This is the hardest trophy on the list and the reason the platinum takes around 200 hours: it folds in the story, the side strands, the collectibles and the big activity counts. Clear the other stages first, then use the checklist to mop up whatever is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts. Push Square counts 397 stunts in the game, so you need a little over half of them. Stunts come from jumps, near misses and air time while driving, so weave them into normal travel instead of grinding them all at once.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample everything: racing, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling and the rest. The trophy pops when the last type is tried, so use it as a tour of the side content in stage 3.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is one of the toughest silvers: work through the challenges weapon by weapon, replay the ones that fall short of gold, and leave it until you have the full arsenal to choose from.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's line first with a slow lap, then race for the win. The trophy pops when the last location is won.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Mix race types and locations so each win counts as a new one, and keep a note of which you have won: repeats do not add to the 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, then out-fish him: steady reeling beats frantic reeling when the line is tense.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade cabinet, play it through to its end, and the trophy pops. The easiest cabinet you enjoy is the right one.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's strand through to its last mission; the trophy pops when that mission ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's strand; the trophy pops at the last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand; the trophy pops at the last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore, so sweep the map between story chapters and follow each strand to its end. Eight finished strands pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand; the trophy pops at the last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand; the trophy pops at the last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy other guides flag as possibly missable: Output Lag reports that Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward the 18 and disappears after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay. Meditate at the balcony spot during Chapter 1, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and sweep the remaining spots as you explore.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's lead to the animal, track it patiently and take a clean shot. A spooked animal costs you the hunt, so approach slowly and use cover.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect full sets one at a time. Track which sets are complete and sweep one region at a time so nothing is left behind.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK spots are spread across the whole map, so this is a long sweep: fold it into exploration and the area visits for The Goodtime State, and tick the map off region by region.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover the game's side goals, and 50 of them is a steady grind best done alongside the other stages. Check the challenge list often and chase the ones nearest completion.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route past three shops, hit them in quick succession with your partner alongside, and keep the wanted level alive the whole way: if it drops, the chain resets.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles count as you drive them, so variety is the trick: steal, borrow and test-drive everything you see instead of sticking to one car.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with at least five enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends. A busy shootout is the easiest place to line it up.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to Vice City International Airport and leave by a route the airport did not schedule: grab a plane and take off without waiting for permission.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The Rhinos are tanks, so this one points at a tank encounter. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet in the guides that have checked: expect it to fire around the Rhino tanks, and treat any precise method as unconfirmed until the community verifies it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: move when the staff look away, keep out of sight lines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vaults, five getaways: plan each escape route before you go in, and do not rush the series. One clean vault at a time.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and break away before the police box you in.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: all 52 areas. Drive every road and visit every corner of the map; the trophy pops when the last area is discovered. Pair it with the WAiNK sweep and the vehicle hunt so one trip does three jobs.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Hit one operation per gang: nine gangs, nine robberies. Keep a checklist of which gangs you have done so none is missed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view: a quiet moment that pops the trophy.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a car in a vehicle showroom and drive it straight out through the glass: the classic GTA exit.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish a game with a proper follow-through.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague: this one is tied to a partner moment, so it should pop from playing the story and side content with your partner. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet in the guides that have checked, so treat any precise method as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. GTABase reports that PSN tracks 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile toward this trophy. Play naturally and make choices: small decisions add up, and check your profile count as you go.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This one pops on a second attempt at something: retry what you just failed and succeed the second time around. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet, so treat any precise method as unconfirmed until the community verifies it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This is the game's strange-encounter trophy: witness something out of the ordinary while exploring Leonida and it pops. Keep your eyes open on long drives and in odd corners of the map.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving past on a bike or in a car, swing a melee weapon and knock someone down: a drive-by with a bat, not a gun.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies: pass them to your contacts to launder them, and keep at it until $250,000 is clean.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Shop normally: clothes, food, gear. The total adds up across every shop, and big purchases near the end of a playthrough finish it off.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage on the market; the trophy pops when the eighth is yours. Save up during the story so the last ones are affordable.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one. Variety counts, so do not register the same model twice.
trophies.name: On the Spot
